title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the escalation of Russian strikes in the EU, particularly on Black Sea shipping, threatening human life, regional stability and food security
part_text: ‘stresses the need for a strengthened eastern flank, from the Arctic to the Black Sea; reiterates that the sovereignty and territorial integrity of all Member States are foundational principles of the EU; underlines that the pattern, location and timing of these attacks are consistent with Russia’s broader strategy of intimidation, its testing of the EU’s capabilities and resolve, extending into the maritime domain, and its long-standing campaign against European Black Sea trade;’
